top_reviews.title: WEERTI THERMAN UNDERWEAR IS WARM AND SOFT
top_reviews.body: WEERTI Thermal underwear is very soft and fits well. The bottoms are like leggings, and will work very well under any jeans, etc. that I own. I did just receive the sets last week, and won't be wearing them yet as I am short and the bottoms are too long. I will have them shortened.

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on March 3, 2026

top_reviews.title: Warm, Soft, and Comfortable Base Layer
top_reviews.body: This thermal set is very warm and comfortable. The fleece lining feels soft and keeps heat in without feeling bulky. Fit is good and it stretches nicely, making it perfect for layering under jeans or winter clothes. Great for cold-weather walks, workdays, or outdoor activities.

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on January 18, 2026

top_reviews.title: Best For Moderate Cold, Not Bulky.
top_reviews.body: This thermal underwear is good as a base layer if you’ll be out in temps in the mid to upper 20’s or above, but it’s not great for extreme cold. It is made of thin material that works well for sliding jeans over due to its lack of bulk. I will continue to use my several sets of Cuddl Duds for the really intense cold while this underwear gets utilized for the more moderate cold. Fit was as expected and it is comfortable with plenty of stretch.

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on January 9, 2026

top_reviews.title: Worked well
top_reviews.body: I ordered these for a trip to Europe in December and really needed the warmth. These were soft, comfortable and warm... great for wearing under all my other layers. These have washed well and held up well... they were a good purchase.

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on January 31, 2026

top_reviews.title: These work
top_reviews.body: The wind chill here has been in 20s and teens. I go outside and jog typically 4 or so miles. These have saved me! By about mile 2 I am sweating! They really work to keep the heat in. Only downside is I hate the feel of them, they feel horrible on my rough hands. They are lightweight and thin, so easy to wear under other layers without it looking like added layers. Great quality. I have definitely got my money's worth.

date.raw: Reviewed in the United States on February 2, 2026

top_reviews.title: Soft, warm not bulky
top_reviews.body: I am very happy with these! The underwear is warm and lightweight. I don't feel like a stuffed sausage with them under my clothes. The sizing chart is spot on and they fit really well. I would highly recommend for anyone who needs an extra layer of warmth for the winter
